# opnsense_monit_service (Data Source)

Retrieves a Monit monitored service by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_monit_service" "example" {
  id = "<uuid>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the service.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Hostname or IP address being checked.
- `depends` (Set of String) Set of other Monit service UUIDs this service depends on.
- `description` (String) Description of the service.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether monitoring of this service is enabled.
- `interface` (String) Network interface being monitored.
- `match` (String) Process match pattern.
- `name` (String) Name of the monitored service.
- `path` (String) Absolute path to the file, directory, or FIFO being monitored.
- `pidfile` (String) Absolute path to the PID file.
- `polltime` (String) Custom cron-like poll schedule for this service.
- `start` (String) Command used to start the service.
- `start_timeout` (String) Grace period, in seconds, given to the service after it starts.
- `stop` (String) Command used to stop the service.
- `tests` (Set of String) Set of Monit test UUIDs applied to this service.
- `timeout` (String) Number of cycles to wait for a start/stop action to complete.
- `type` (String) Type of service check.
